query:
INSERT INTO quotation_items
          (quotation_id, line_no, name, spec, unit, quantity, unit_price, unit_cost, amount, note)
        SELECT $1, * FROM UNNEST(
          $2::int[], $3::text[], $4::text[], $5::text[],
          $6::numeric[], $7::numeric[], $8::numeric[], $9::numeric[], $10::text[]
        )
